entities.summary: The Hovhannes Tumanyan Puppet Theatre of Yerevan, officially the National Puppet Theatre after Hovhannes Tumanyan, is a puppet theatre founded in 1935 and located in Yerevan, Armenia. It is also the location of the Pavlos Boroyan Puppet Museum.
